method: Playwright Chromium at 1440x1000, actual Scripts and File Cabinet components with mocked read responses. Scripts fixture inherits the 12px font used by NetSuiteView. ORVANE_SCRIPTS_BASELINE=1 enables the diagnostic on the baseline checkout.
context: DOM/layout diagnostics, not foreground frame-rate, latency or heap measurements

oneExpandedScript.policy: Expanded records remain mounted, including inner log/preview scroll and native controls; only the surrounding collapsed list is windowed.

limits: Mounted expanded panels grow with the number of expanded scripts; this does not bound a many-expanded-panel workload.
Application filters and sorting use the full script set; browser-native Find sees mounted text.
The installed desktop bridge limits each log response to the first 100 records and global search to 100 folders plus 100 files; other request providers may differ.
Foreground 50-app timing, heap and soak validation remain pending.
